Preserve Riven's facial identity, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, large sword design, and overall appearance exactly as shown in the reference. Riven is an experienced and highly trained adult swordswoman. FATHER: Use the provided Father reference image as the strict character reference. Preserve his facial identity, age, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and overall appearance. He is Riven's experienced sword instructor and father. === ENVIRONMENT LOCK === Use the provided village/home reference. The scene takes place in the familiar outdoor training yard beside their cottage in the mountain village. Natural daylight. Quiet peaceful atmosphere. Gentle wind. Only Riven and Father are present. === TECHNICAL === High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy. 16:9 cinematic widescreen. Feature-film quality. Realistic human anatomy. Natural human movement. Believable sword weight and physical interaction. Realistic cloth and hair physics. Keep the sword practice simple, controlled, readable, and natural. This is a calm training lesson between two experienced swordsmen. All dialogue must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY. Speak the written dialogue exactly as written. No additional dialogue. No subtitles. No captions. No text. No watermark. No logo. === GLOBAL ACTION === Father leads a controlled sword-training exercise with Riven. He sets the rhythm of the practice while Riven responds to him. Keep their sword movements simple and natural. The important purpose of the exercise is for Father to teach Riven to read the movement of the person in front of her instead of focusing only on the sword. There is no competition and no need to establish a winner. === SCENE === Begin with a clear medium-wide view showing Riven and Father practicing together in the training yard. Father leads the exercise. Riven follows his movements and responds naturally with her large sword. Their blades meet during the controlled practice. CLANG. They continue briefly. Father notices Riven watching his sword too closely. He pauses. He looks at Riven and says: "Don't watch the blade." Riven looks at him. Father says: "Watch me." They resume the same controlled exercise. This time Riven watches Father's posture and body movement rather than staring at his sword. Her response becomes noticeably more confident and instinctive. Father sees that she understands. They stop naturally. Riven gives a small confident smile. Riven: "Again?" Father gives a subtle approving look. Father: "Again." Riven raises her sword and focuses directly on Father. Father calmly prepares to continue the lesson. CUT. === END STATE FOR CONTINUITY === Riven and Father remain together in the training yard. Both are calm and unharmed. Riven has understood Father's lesson. They are ready to continue practicing, but the video ends before the next exercise begins. === MOOD === Grounded cinematic sword training. Calm, focused, disciplined, and familiar. The emphasis is on teaching and learning rather than conflict.、16:9
